visual.general_description: Grayscale radiographic image of the upper abdomen showing a long curved thin tubular structure with a rounded dark region at its upper end.
visual.detailed_description: Single grayscale radiographic (fluoroscopy-type) image of the upper abdomen, portrait orientation. A long, thin, curved dark tubular structure runs from near the upper centre down and to the left, ending near the lower left. Near its upper end there is a rounded, dark ovoid region with a lighter irregular area immediately below and to its right. Large soft-tissue shadows and indistinct bony outlines fill the lower left, and a darker textured region lies on the right. A row of small ruler-type tick marks runs along the bottom edge with a small "v" glyph near the centre and a partially cropped unit label at the lower right that is not fully legible. No panel letters, arrows, annotations or patient identifiers are visible. The caption locates the gallstone near the top of the common bile duct; the image itself does not label the stone.

visual.general_description: Grayscale radiographic image showing a thin curved wire forming a loop with a small dark tip near the centre.
visual.detailed_description: Single grayscale radiographic (fluoroscopy-type) image, roughly square. A thin dark wire enters from the top, curves down the left side, bends sharply at the lower left where a short thicker dark segment sits, and sweeps back up and to the right forming an open loop; a separate short dark filament ending in a small dark rounded tip lies near the centre of the loop. A bright, dense soft-tissue shadow occupies the left edge and a darker textured region lies on the right. A small "v" glyph is at the bottom centre with faint tick marks along the lower edge. No panel letters, arrows, text or patient identifiers are visible. The caption states this is the Dormia basket in the CBD after the handle broke with the endoscope removed.

visual.general_description: Circular endoscopic view with a dark irregular central mass surrounded by tan and yellow-white material, bright reflections and a pink-red area.
visual.detailed_description: Color circular endoscopic field on a black surround with a visible raster or mesh texture over the whole image. The centre shows a dark, irregular reddish-brown to black cavity-like mass with ragged edges. A tan and yellow-white granular surface lies to the left and below it, with bright linear metallic-type reflections at the upper left. To the right there is a broad bright white and pink-red glare area. A small notch interrupts the circular edge at the lower left. No text, panel letters, arrows or patient identifiers are visible. The caption states this is a choledochoscopic view of the distal CBD with a large stone seen within the impacted ERCP Dormia basket.

visual.general_description: Circular endoscopic view with a bright metallic-type linear structure crossing from the left towards the centre over tan and grey-purple tissue-like surfaces.
visual.detailed_description: Color circular endoscopic field on a black surround with a visible raster or mesh texture. A bright white and grey metallic-type linear structure with sharp reflections runs from the left edge towards the centre. A grey-purple, mottled surface fills the upper part, an orange-tan streaked area lies to the right of centre, and a pale cream-yellow smooth surface occupies the lower half with a small red spot at the lower right. A small notch interrupts the circular edge at the bottom centre. No text, panel letters, arrows or patient identifiers are visible. The caption states that the debulked ERCP Dormia basket is now collapsed and ready for removal, with few remaining stone fragments.
